insights: Shorts significantly outperform long-form videos, averaging over 1,000 views compared to under 60 views for long-form content.
Shorts utilizing the 'Myth vs fact' style achieved the highest performance, exemplified by the Artemis III and Maglev train shorts scoring above 1.2 with over 90% average view percentage.
Opening hooks in shorts need tighter pacing, as drop-off spikes frequently occur within the first 5 to 8 seconds of playback.
Long-form videos suffer from low initial click-through and reach, despite decent retention rates among viewers who actually start watching.
Ending calls-to-action in shorts underperform for engagement, as nearly all videos across the dataset recorded zero comments.
Space and aerospace topics (such as Artemis III and satellites) yield high viewer retention and strong engagement relative to other technological categories.
